about: The secreta of the formulary “Nativity of the Lord — Mass during the Night” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: May the offering of this day’s solemnity be acceptable unto Thee, O Lord, we beseech Thee, that by Thy bountiful grace, through this most sacred exchange, we may be found conformed to Him in Whom our nature is with Thee. Who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,

a.g: the offering of this day’s solemnity
by the bounty of Thy grace
we may be found in His likeness

ex.w012: Tua grátia largiénte is an ablative absolute: Thy grace does the bestowing. It is not being bestowed. The phrase presents the requested likeness to Christ as a gift of grace.
